scenario.title: Packs: discover, adopt, customize and update
situations: A project needs a reusable capability.
An installed Pack has an update or local customizations.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Can a user read each full Pack contract before installing it through a supported external-project route?
Does the workbench teach stale report versus newer version rather than one undifferentiated stale state?

lessons.title: Find the available and installed choices
lessons.when: Before proposing new reusable implementation or selecting an Onboard profile
lessons.need: Use the project-scoped catalog; distinguish available, installed and stale. Read dependencies, tool prerequisites, source catalog and installed version.
lessons.surface: Docs sidebar -> Projects -> Packs; Onboard profile -> yoke packs list; documented workbench Packs page.

lessons.title: Reach the Pack-specific instructions
lessons.when: After selecting a Pack, before treating it as suitable or ready
lessons.need: Read the selected Pack README and its application/runbook children; its installed files become project-owned source. A Pack description is not its setup or support contract.
lessons.surface: Catalog JSON has documentation; installed entry is docs/packs/<slug>/README.md. Plain packs list output prints description/tools but omits that documentation pointer.
lessons.gap: Proven narrow omission in human list output. Pre-install availability of complete Pack docs and actual workbench link behavior are not established.

lessons.title: Preview updates and preserve customization
lessons.when: Before first apply, a version update, or recovery from a conflict
lessons.need: Preview first. Installed receipt is the baseline; repeating get is not an update. Read the exact Pack conflict recipe, do not overwrite custom files or rewrite immutable historical versions.
lessons.surface: Onboard profile -> selected installed README; packs get/update help and preview result.

lessons.title: Record a project-owned move
lessons.when: A customized application file has moved since its Pack baseline
lessons.need: Use Pack relink to record the move. Relink does not move files; co-owned AGENTS and ignore contributions cannot be relinked. A source-installed version may need its original catalog until served.
lessons.surface: Projects -> Packs catalog contract; relink help; selected Pack README.
